#!/usr/bin/env bash
LINE_MAX=${LINE_MAX:-500}
count=0
skipped=0

normalize() {
    local s=$1
    s=${s//$'\t'/ }
    s=${s##+([[:space:]])}
    printf '%s\n' "$s"
}

while IFS= read -r line; do
    if [[ -z $line ]] || [[ $line == \#* ]]; then
        skipped=$(( skipped + 1 ))
        continue
    fi
    if [[ $count -lt $LINE_MAX ]] && [[ ${#line} -gt 0 ]]; then
        normalize "$line"
        count=$(( count + 1 ))
    fi
done < "${1:-/dev/stdin}"

printf 'kept=%d skipped=%d\n' "$count" "$skipped"
